name: Enkanomiya
description: It can be entered via a deep pool east of Sangonomiya Shrine. According to legend, the Watatsumi people originated from here. Enkanomiya is located under Watatsumi Island, and can be considered either part of Teyvat, even though it is somewhat disconnected from it, or fully separate and part of the Dark Sea, instead. To enter Enkanomiya, the seals on the five Goshou Rocks need to be broken. The pearls located within the five shrines are needed for the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep, which would allow entry to Enkanomiya, provided that the spirit veins connecting Enkanomiya and Watatsumi Island are flowing smoothly and a person whose heart is "as clear as water." According to legend, the key was forged from Orobashi's blood.
